sections.advice: This High point near Incheon → Near Bucheon-si stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Scenic stretch near Gwangjeok → Photo stop near Yangju is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

sections.to: Near Pubal, on the way back
sections.advice: Photo stop near Yangju → Near Pubal, on the way back can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

sections.from: Near Pubal, on the way back

sections.advice: Food stop near Icheon-si → Back to East Sea Coastal is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 17 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Route Napoleon
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 57 km this is Route Napoleon, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: From the Great Saltworks of Salins-les-Bai → Lac de Chalain
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 41 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Bieszczady Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 40 km this is Bieszczady Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-terebowiec-stream-valley-bardejov.story: A 364 km round trip from Lutowiska - roughly 6 h 17 in the saddle. The stops in between: Havešová Primeval Forest, Turzańsk-Tserkva of Saint Michael the Arch, Bodruzal and Bardejov Town Conservation Reserve. It crosses from Poland into Slovakia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. Rivers set the line for much of the day.
